Raw --no-baseline count is 184 T010 BLOCKERs (not 88; the 88 predates PR #490 which wired 55 orphaned test files into build). Residual exit 1 in this session traced to C4, not C5: (a) stale process BPM_TEST_DB_URL on port 5434 (workspace 1) shadowing .env's 5453, and (b) two unapplied migrations in local db_test. Both environment, not repo defects.
